proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Brand new house in Meridian with nothing out back. Dale walked the lot with the plat map, found the corner pins and pulled a string before anyone dug. The fence is dead straight along 180 feet.
reviews.name: Brittany S.

reviews.text: Two sections went down in the March wind. They came the next week, reset the posts deeper in concrete and matched the cedar so you can barely see which part is new.
reviews.name: Tom R.

reviews.text: They called 811 for us and waited for the flags before digging. Good thing, the gas line ran right where I wanted the gate post. Moved it two feet, no drama.
reviews.name: Anita P.

reviews.text: Our old gate dragged for years. The new one has a steel frame inside the cedar and it swings shut on its own. Kids cannot leave it open anymore.
reviews.name: Jesse W.

reviews.text: Deck is composite, framed tighter than the other two bids, and they showed me the flashing tape at the house before covering it. Feels solid when twenty people stand on it.
reviews.name: Carla M.

reviews.text: Fence was going grey after three summers. They washed it, let it dry two days and stained it. It looks like the week it went in. Price matched the quote.
reviews.name: Luke D.

proof.guarantee: If a post we set leans in the first 5 years, we come back and reset it at no charge.

prices.note: posts every 8 ft, set in concrete
